name: fig6-gene-essentiality
title: Fig 6A — Single-gene-disruption essentiality: model vs experiment
question:
Does the viva-Mgen FBA metabolism submodel reproduce Fig 6A — the
single-gene-disruption essentiality phenotype — for the metabolic genes of
M. genitalium: does an in-silico single-gene knockout predict which genes are
essential, matching the reference essentiality calls?
hypothesis:
For the ~125 genes the iPS189 metabolic reconstruction covers (the paper notes
metabolic-gene disruptions are the most debilitating), a single-gene FBA
knockout that collapses growth should mark the gene essential, and the
model-vs-reference confusion matrix should land near the paper's whole-cell
accuracy (~79% overall; ~87% for the iPS189 metabolic model on essentiality).
objective:
For every metabolic gene with a reference call, run a single-gene FBA knockout
via MetabolismFbaReproductionProcess, call it essential when growth_fraction
drops below 0.05, cross-tabulate against the reference calls into a 2x2
confusion matrix, and score accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity. Also run
the fig6_gene_essentiality composite once for a representative essential gene
(MG_023) to record a canonical baseline and confirm growth collapses.
description:
HIGH FIDELITY over the metabolic subset. Essentiality is assessed only for the
125 genes present in the published Suthers 2009 iPS189 reconstruction that also
carry a reference essentiality call — not all 525 M. genitalium genes. This is
the appropriate scope: FBA can only speak to metabolic-gene disruptions, which
the paper identifies as the most debilitating. A gene is called model-essential
when its single knockout drives FBA growth_fraction below 0.05 (growth
collapse). Reference essentiality is the ``essential_ref`` column of
``datasets/genes.csv``, extracted from the Karr 2012 repo's
allDeletionSimulations.json. Achieved (committed production run over 125 genes):
accuracy 0.760, sensitivity 0.755, specificity 0.789; confusion matrix
[[TP 80, FN 26], [FP 4, TN 15]] (106 reference-essential, 19 reference-
non-essential). The representative MG_023 knockout collapses growth_fraction to
0.000, confirming detection of an essential gene.

conclusion:
viva-Mgen reproduces the Fig 6A single-gene-disruption essentiality phenotype
over the metabolic subset at HIGH fidelity: across the 125 iPS189 metabolic
genes with a reference essentiality call, single-gene FBA knockouts recover the
reference classification with 0.760 accuracy (sensitivity 0.755, specificity
0.789), in the neighborhood of the paper's 79% whole-cell and ~87% iPS189
metabolic figures. Confusion matrix [[TP 80, FN 26], [FP 4, TN 15]] over 106
reference-essential and 19 reference-non-essential genes. Essentiality is
called by growth collapse (growth_fraction < 0.05); the representative MG_023
knockout collapses growth to 0.000.
